axes.brief: Electoral presidential/Assembly selection continues under concentrated executive power, opposition prosecution and weak implementation of judicial constraints.
axes.counterEvidence: Article104 law-over-decree limits, Article105 criminal removal and elections are retained; snap elections are not unilateral postponement and political prosecutions are not a fabricated exclusive presidential ballot veto.

answers.rationale: Educated assumption: Regular national elections and actual opposition electoral wins remain, qualified by serious campaign/repression inequalities. Agreement reflects continuing electoral selection, not full competitive fairness.
President/Assembly are chosen through elections, not sovereign expert-panel selection.

Educated assumption: Adult franchise is independent of intelligence/education, with defined legal exceptions. Qualified agreement; candidacy degree qualification is not voter education and all exceptions not consolidated.

Article104 limits presidential decrees: statutory provisions prevail and Assembly law on same matter voids decree. Strong executive practice does not grant unlimited enactment against rejected parliament.
Actual opposition participation persists but prosecutions, censorship and removal seriously undermine same campaign conditions.

Educated assumption: Parliamentary oversight/committees include opposition, while executive dominance and intimidation impede investigation. Qualified agreement; precise all budget-committee powers not consolidated.

Educated assumption: Constitutional review exists and sometimes protects rights, while actual domestic decisions are ignored and judiciary controlled. Mixed reversal capacity/implementation, not zero from missing evidence.
Union leaders have no national constitutional government-selection power.

Educated assumption: Actual politically targeted candidacy/prosecution/exclusion and party restrictions favor some leadership ability to exclude. Qualified agreement; formal party-closure decisions require courts, not invented presidential sole ballot power.
Educated assumption: Constitutional-amendment referendums do not establish voter-initiated ordinary-law repeal. Qualified disagreement; every statutory referendum remedy not inventoried.

Educated assumption: Concentrated presidential executive policy/appointment powers favor substantial unilateral major-policy authority. Qualified agreement because statute/courts/Assembly still impose formal limits.
Article105 defines Assembly investigation/referral and criminal-tribunal conviction ending mandate, with high thresholds; not ordinary parliamentary no-confidence dismissal.

Educated assumption: War-related Assembly postponement and presidential snap-election renewal do not permit unilateral political-continuity delay. Qualified disagreement; every extraordinary electoral practice unmeasured.
Educated assumption: Party/ministerial local removal and judicial mandates are not a defined constituent recall vote. Qualified disagreement; all municipal electoral instruments not consolidated.

Educated assumption: Actual executive impunity/dominance weakens accountability, but electoral and Assembly constitutional constraints persist. Moderate disagreement rather than no democratic account whatsoever.
Constitution117 civilian command and actual anti-coup governance reject soldiers’ unilateral civilian-government replacement.

axes.counterEvidence: Weak review is not proof of no courts, surveillance not exact movement-retention duration, firearmlicensing not universal entitlement and online government services not universal platformID.

answers.rationale: Educated assumption: Nonviolent drugs remain prohibited within personal conduct regulation, while other private adult choices are allowed. Qualified disagreement; no blanket all self-regarding acts banned claim.
